about_the_game:
The party room is typically seen as a place full of joy and energy, but in Balloon Party, it stands in stark contrast to the concept of “joy.”
The story begins on a quiet morning when you awaken from a coma, finding yourself in a strange party room. Colorful balloons float around you, creating an eerie atmosphere. You try to find an exit, but there’s no way out. In this enclosed space, toxic gas fills the air, and an invisible sense of oppression creeps in, as if an unknown entity is secretly controlling everything.

Inside the room, you discover a mysterious message instructing you to follow the will of an unknown figure, completing a series of assigned tasks to have a chance at freedom. These tasks center around the balloons in the room, requiring you to interact with them to uncover hidden clues and seek a chance to escape.

Gameplay
Balloon Party is a mildly terrifying game blending simulation and exploration elements. Players take on the role of someone trapped in a party room, interacting with the environment and balloons to unravel the mystery and find a way out. The game demands keen observation and logical reasoning, requiring players to carefully inspect every detail of the room, collect key clues, and solve balloon-related puzzles.

Throughout the exploration, players will face multiple challenges, such as deciphering hidden messages on balloons, avoiding dangerous traps, and dealing with sudden, terrifying situations. As the game progresses, the tension in the room escalates, delivering an immersive experience filled with suspense and unease.

Game Features

  • Engaging Storyline: Set in a mysterious party room, players gradually uncover the hidden truth.

  • Interactive Environment: Freely explore the room, interact with balloons and other objects to discover the key to freedom.

  • Horror Atmosphere: Carefully crafted sound and visual effects create a tense and oppressive experience.

  • Test of Intellect and Courage: Challenges players’ observation, reasoning, and psychological resilience for a well-rounded thrilling experience.

Balloon Party offers a unique adventure. In this seemingly joyful yet enigmatic party room, can you complete the tasks and find a way to escape? Prepare for the ultimate challenge of this mildly terrifying game.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or Windows 11
  • Processor: Core i5 processor or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 760 or AMD Radeon™ R7 260x with 2GB Video RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）

  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX1060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11

  • Sound Card: DirectSound compatible（must support DirectX 9.0c or higher）

short_description: The party room was supposed to be a joyful place, but is it really connected to “joy”? You need to interact with various objects in the party room and complete a series of explorations to find a glimmer of hope for escape. Can you... break free?
